Name: Coal Fruit Trees by Wickedy
Author: WickedyWoah
Description:
[b][size=5]Hey, Hi, Howdy, and Hello

[/size][/b]I love coal trees, but they are so rare! The chances that lighting will strike a fruit tree are so low, actually impossible for me due to the fact that I place all my fruit trees indoors... anyway, I love them and want to collect them all.

[center]So, introducing permanent [b][size=4]Coal Fruit Trees![/size][/b] (no lightning required)[/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/vMBrouu.png[/img][/center]


But these are a little different from your standard coal trees, they produce a special "Coal Fruit." Coal Fruit can be harvested from all of these trees during fall, and if you pop them into a charcoal kiln you'll get back 5-10 coal each.

[center][b][size=4]Coal Fruit and Saplings[/size][/b][/center]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/haKqBni.png[/img]﻿[/center]

The Coal Fruit tree saplings can't be bought, rather you have to make them. Just pop a standard fruit tree sapling into a furnace and you'll get back a coal tree sapling of whatever type of vanilla tree you popped in there. There are 8 types, some with different seasonal variants, and they take 28 days to grow.

Note: unlike regular coal trees, these aren't as hazardous to the environment and won't emit charred smoke.
